scope: Repository-authored analytic synthetic engineering court. It tests linear world-space recovery and failure accounting; it cannot establish acquired-MRI, clinical, or general superiority claims.

candidate.source_tree_hash_contract: SHA-256 over every non-target regular file below modules/reframe4s-flashalign, sorted by repository-relative path, with each path and byte payload prefixed by its unsigned eight-byte big-endian length

fixtures.independence_contract: A standard-library Python generator samples a closed-form continuous phantom directly on each physical grid; no candidate transform, interpolation, objective, or optimizer code generates truth.

comparator.name: 3dAllineate
comparator.matrix_contract: AFNI base-to-source DICOM/RAI matrix is inverted and conjugated by diag(-1,-1,1,1) to obtain source/moving-to-base/fixed RAS world geometry.

protocol.initialization: The exact 4x4 world identity is supplied to Flashalign and is AFNI onepass default. No capture, center-of-mass shift, or twopass search is permitted in either lane.
protocol.case_order: case table order; Flashalign then 3dAllineate for each case

estimands.primary_error: Independent world-landmark RMS in millimetres. A non-success receives the predeclared 100 mm adjudication penalty.
estimands.median_difference: Flashalign minus 3dAllineate median adjudicated RMS within cohort and model.
estimands.p95_difference: Flashalign minus 3dAllineate p95 adjudicated RMS within cohort and model.
estimands.catastrophic_difference: Flashalign minus 3dAllineate rate of non-success or landmark RMS greater than 5 mm.
estimands.uncertainty: Paired nonparametric bootstrap of four subject clusters, 10000 replicates, seed 20260912.
estimands.superiority_rule: The upper endpoint of every subject-clustered 95% interval for median, p95, and catastrophic-rate difference must be strictly below zero within every declared cohort/model cell.
estimands.fixture_accuracy_gate: All four ordinary rigid Flashalign cases must succeed with independent landmark RMS <= 0.1 mm.

failure_accounting.rule: Every one of 32 cases produces one Flashalign and one 3dAllineate row. Crashes, timeout, ambiguity, nonconvergence, invalid geometry, insufficient overlap/information, and unavailable execution remain in the original cohort denominator.

permitted: matched local rigid and affine comparison
